title: Process blacklist
intro: Processes on the blacklist are terminated as soon as they appear, to stop bundled software from running on its own, starting wallpaper tasks on the lock screen, or opening browsers by itself. Matching is by complete value, case-insensitive: adding from the details pane records the exe's full path and terminates only that file; a name typed here counts as a complete image name (one without an extension reads as .exe: 360 means 360.exe and never touches 360safe.exe).
added: Added to the blacklist: {name}, terminated on sight
watchHint: Blacklist active ({count} entries): every sample terminates matching processes as they appear
